notes: Locations get their own rules: a pick priority, one SKU only or mixed, and a hard size and weight limit (anything that would go over is refused, and putaway only suggests places the load fits), set on each location's page or in bulk, and exported and re-imported as a CSV to change many at once. SKUs get a Size & weight tab for each, pack, carton and pallet. Every line on an ASN has a Receive button with the SKU, lot and quantity filled in. Batch picks get a number printed with a barcode on the slip. Scan mode is simpler: it tells you the one next thing to scan, and moving stock never asks for a lot number. A SKU's unit of measure is Each, Pack, Carton or Pallet, and auto-generated ASN numbers can carry your own prefix and suffix. Also includes 1.30.0 and security updates.
